movie.title: Other Mommy
movie.overview: A young girl, Bela, forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home who looks uncannily like her own mother.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A young girl and her family are terrorized by a malevolent entity that uses psychological manipulation to coax her into letting it possess her body.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: A peaceful household is shattered when a sinister entity targets a young girl, seeking to inhabit her body from within. Bound by a chilling rule, the malicious spirit cannot possess her outright and instead works to coax and manipulate her into granting it permission. As supernatural occurrences escalate throughout the home, the girl's family must fight to uncover the true nature of the threat before she gives in to the creature's eerie persuasion.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: A suburban family faces an unthinkable nightmare when their home becomes the target of a deceptive supernatural presence. The entity sets its sights on the family's young daughter, aiming to take permanent residence inside her body. However, the sinister force cannot force its way in and must rely on insidious psychological tactics to persuade the child to invite it inside. Strange phenomena begin happening around the house, slowly isolating the young girl and exploiting her innocence and vulnerabilities. As the emotional strain tears at the family's bonds, her parents struggle to differentiate between genuine behavioral distress and a dark, malicious force at work. The entity grows increasingly aggressive and manipulative, assuming unsettling forms to earn the child's trust. Desperate to shield her from harm, the family races against time to break the spirit's psychological hold over their daughter. Ultimately, they are forced into a dire confrontation to prevent the child from making a catastrophic choice that could cost her soul.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Other Mommy is a tension-filled horror-drama that explores the psychological vulnerability of childhood and the sanctity of the family home. When an otherworldly entity fixates on a young girl, it initiates an unsettling campaign to win her consent so it can possess her body. Operating through insidious trickery, quiet manipulation, and escalating supernatural disturbances, the threat forces the girl's family to battle a malevolent presence that targets their deepest fears and domestic fractures. Striking a balance between grounded emotional drama and atmospheric dread, the film builds a slow-burning sense of terror surrounding the fight to protect an innocent child from giving away her very self.

story_structure.climax: The tension reaches its absolute peak as the entity makes its final, most aggressive push to force or trick the girl into letting it in, forcing her and her family into a desperate psychological and supernatural battle for control.
story_structure.conflict: A sinister, malevolent entity manifests in the home, targeting the young girl with the specific, terrifying goal of taking up residence inside her body.
story_structure.resolution: The immediate confrontation concludes, establishing the ultimate fate of the girl's autonomy and revealing the lingering aftermath of the entity's invasion attempt on the family and their home.
story_structure.introduction: A young girl and her family are introduced living in their home, establishing their normal daily routines and relationships before any supernatural disturbances begin.
story_structure.risingAction: The entity escalates its haunting, using psychological manipulation, illusions, and unsettling encounters to break down the girl's resolve and deceptively persuade her to grant it permission to enter.
